testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect a document tab's context menu: tmp/obk-tab-context-3900/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:20:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a document tab's context menu ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user opens the document tab's context menu ✔ Then the menu offers Close, Close Tabs, Close All, Save and Properties ✔ And it displays shortcuts for Close and Save ✔ When the user dismisses the menu ✔ Then the document remains active
